description: Restored queries inside ordinary nested queries retain complete window identities. (Engine §4.4.)
grammar:
%rule text $p:A B
%conditions $p.parse(… tail) ∧ $.parse(… tail)
%rule tail $a:A [B]
%conditions $a.parse(inner)
%rule inner A [+T]
%conditions $.without-elision.onward.parse(deeper …)
%rule deeper A [+T]
